'''Doirellin''' is a member of the [[Children of the Light]].

==Appearance==
Doirellin is almost as wide as he is tall, with barely an once of fat on him. He has a high-pitched voice, which no one dares make fun of.

==History==
He can put walnuts between each of his fingers and crack them by clenching his fist.

==Activities==
When [[Galad Damodred]] suggests allying with anyone who is willing to join the fight against the [[Seanchan]], Doirellin queries this and suggests that it could mean Aes Sedai. Galad says that fighting alongside Aes Sedai will be necessary if he wants to fight at Tarmon Gai'don, to which Doirellin nods slowly.
